source_extracts.label: Cox residential equipment return deadline
source_extracts.quote: Cox equipment must be returned within 15 calendar days to avoid unreturned equipment charges.

source_extracts.label: Cox service change before equipment return
source_extracts.quote: To avoid potential charges, contact us to downgrade or disconnect the service before returning your equipment.

source_extracts.label: Account-specific return inventory
source_extracts.quote: Equipment that needs to be returned will be listed in the e-mail sent after a change in services.

source_extracts.label: Cox residential equipment list
source_extracts.quote: The following items must be returned to avoid charges: Digital Receivers; Power Cords / Power Supplies; Internet Modems; Telephone Modems; Remote Controls; Gigablast customers supplied Netgear router.

source_extracts.label: Cox return destinations
source_extracts.quote: Retail Store — Find a Spectrum Retail Store near you. UPS Store — For the nearest location, refer to UPS Store Locator.

source_extracts.label: Cox drop-off cost and packaging instructions
source_extracts.quote: There is no fee to drop your equipment off using one of the below methods. A return box and a shipping label are not needed when dropping off your equipment at a return location.

source_extracts.label: Condition of returned equipment
source_extracts.quote: To avoid any fees, equipment must be returned in the same condition it was received.

source_extracts.label: Purchased equipment refund route and deadline
source_extracts.quote: Purchased equipment must be returned to a Cox-owned retail store within 30 days of purchase for a refund by the method used for purchase.

source_extracts.label: Cox Mobile return label exception
source_extracts.quote: For Cox Mobile Devices, do not take the device to a UPS store without a return label provided by an agent. Contact us to get the return shipping label.
